Messages.Author: Jozxyqk
Messages.Body:
Reindoctrination [LoB:C]
Cardtype:  Action
Clan:  Tremere/Tremere antitribu
Cost:  2 blood
+1 stealth action.
Choose a younger Gargoyle. That Gargoyle loses any existing slave status
and becomes a slave to this acting vampire's clan. Take control of the
Gargoyle if another Methuselah controls him or her, move the Gargoyle to
your ready region, and untap him or her. 

One comment/confirmation, and another (warning, very stupid) question:

1) Can you use Reindoctrination to rescue your own gargoyles from
torpor? It says "move to your ready region".
It would be good because: a) you can use Ankara with it, and b) it
untaps the gargoyle.

2) OK, so let's say Qadir ul-Ghani uses his special ability to become a
Gargoyle.  Then a Tremere plays Reindoctrination on him.  Then Qadir
uses his ability to become an Assamite again.  Is he now an Independent
Tremere Slave Assamite?
